$comment: Descriptive, derived from the types the bounded parser reads; the parser is the only authority on validity. Where the parser reads two versions of a document with one type, this schema admits what that type admits, including members the later version adds. Byte, depth and count bounds are recorded in x-rustev-parse-limits (a string length here counts characters, the parser counts bytes), and rules applied when a plan is compiled are stated in field descriptions, not enforced here.

Admission.description:
The new decision's admission (spec 003, 3.4): a document exists only for
an admitted decision.

oneOf.description: A valid output.
The decision deadline passed while it was in flight.
The caller cancelled while it was in flight.

AttemptRole.description: Which kind of external attempt is proposed.

oneOf.description: The first attempt on the bound backend.
A further attempt on the same target.
The first attempt on a declared fallback target.

AuthorizationOutcome.description: What the host answered for one proposed attempt, as kept for evidence.

reference.description: The host's reference, when its answer carried one.

AuthorizationRefusal.description:
Why an attempt was not authorized. Each prevents dispatch and is
recorded as `authorization_refused` (spec 026, 3.3).

oneOf.description: The host gave no answer.
The answer's validity ended before dispatch.
The answer names a different request.
The host's authorizer failed or panicked.
The host refused.

Availability.description:
What a retained input is at replay time. Only `available` contributes
to reproduction; none of the others is a pass.

oneOf.description: Digest-only, or the host has no such bytes.
`now_ms >= expires_at_ms`; takes precedence over erasure at replay.
The host reports the bytes erased before expiry.

The bytes do not match the digest, are not valid JSON, or are not in
record canonical form.
The host refused, failed or panicked while resolving.
Intact bytes with a wrong schema, identity, cross-reference or role.
The backend confirmed that its work and charges stopped.
The backend answered without confirming a remote stop.
The runtime stopped waiting before any answer.

Cancellation.description: What is known about cancelling an attempt (spec 003, 3.7.3).

CapturePosture.description:
The new run's capture, chosen independently of the historical case and
off by default (spec 026, 3.7).

CaptureStatus.description: Whether every supplied value was captured. Only `complete` reproduces.

oneOf.description: The byte or request cap was hit; captured payloads were discarded.

Change.description: Whether a compared member changed. Unknown is never unchanged.

Charge.description: What an attempt cost, as far as is known when it ends.

ComparisonDefinition.description:
What is compared: an explicitly named proposal payload or outcome
category, chosen by a versioned task adapter. Full judgment bytes are
never the agreement metric.

fields.description: The proposal payload fields compared beside the action; at most 64.

ComparisonOutcome.description: The result of comparing the live proposal with the historical one.

oneOf.description:
The named fields agree. Not determinism, calibration, quality,
correctness or authorization.
The named fields differ. Not a failed historical reproduction.
A historical item is not available; the source is not restored.
The historical case or the live result cannot be compared.

ComparisonSection.description: The comparison member of a live document.

CostBound.description: A backend's per-call cost disclosure, before dispatch.

oneOf.description: The call cannot cost more than this.

CostComparison.description: Observed, estimated and unknown cost, kept apart, of each side.

CostSummary.description: A decision's cost at the moment its record was built (spec 003, 3.5.6).

liability.description: Reservations kept because the final cost is unknown.

within_guaranteed_cap.description: True only under `hard` with no liability and no bound violation.

DeliveryObservation.description: What became of the new run record's delivery (spec 003, 3.9.4).

oneOf.description:
The sink's receipt, at most 256 bytes; acceptance under the sink's
own terms, not verified durability.
Handed to the delivery worker; the outcome arrives on the ticket.

Dispatch.description: Whether a proposed attempt was sent, and what it observably did.

oneOf.description: Nothing was sent.

Exposure.description:
The worst-case cost of one proposed attempt: the backend's disclosure and
the units reserved for it before it was presented.

FailureClass.description:
How a dispatched attempt failed (spec 003, 3.6.1). Deadline and
cancellation are not classes: they end a request, and are never retried
or a fallback trigger.

oneOf.description: The output failed the core's validation.
The adapter says the failure may not recur.
The adapter says the backend refused for load.
The adapter says the failure will recur for this input.
The attempt timeout passed.
The adapter panicked.

Historical.description: The historical case, or its explicit absence.

HistoricalLink.description:
A historical case, linked by digest and identities only: never embedded
historical content (spec 026, 3.7).

bundle_digest.description: The record digest of the `rustev.replay/1` bundle.

HistoricalRetention.description:
What is known of the historical case's retention. Live re-execution
never extends it and never restores an item (spec 026, 3.7).

oneOf.description: No historical case is linked.
Linked, and not resolved: the runtime reads only the link.
Observed at comparison time.

unavailable.description:
Items that were not available, explicitly; empty when every item
that was resolved was available.

IdentityChanges.description: Identity changes between the historical case and the live run.

artifacts.description: The artifacts whose outputs were supplied.

served_identity.description: A served identity is not recorded by `rustev.run/1`.

ItemObservation.description: One historical item's availability, as observed at comparison.

LiveComparison.description: The comparison of a finished live run with a verified historical case.

exclusions.description: What was left out of the comparison, and why; at most 64.

historical_result.description: The historical and live outcome categories, by the adapter's names.

limitations.description: What the comparison does not establish; at most 64.

LiveEffect.description:
One proposed external attempt of the new decision: what was presented,
the host's answer, and the effect. Every attempted effect is attributable
to the new decision by its attempt id (spec 026, 3.6).

presented.description: The digest of the request the host was asked about.

ObservationChanges.description: New backend, policy, calibration and runtime observations.

policy.description: The definition, whose selection policy is part of it.

OtherChanges.description: Cancellation, remote-state, retention and delivery differences.

oneOf.description: The backend returned a result of its own accord.
The backend acknowledged a cancellation as stopped.
Nothing establishes that remote work or charges stopped.
A proposal on either side, and the named outcome differs.
Abstentions on both sides, of different categories.
No comparison of results was possible.

RunLink.description: The new run record, linked by digest; it stays the evidence of execution.

RuntimeObservations.description: Counts of runtime observations of one side.

Scope.description: The isolation scope of a capture, a bundle and every request identity.

oneOf.description:
Reuse across principals within one tenant and context revision: an
explicit host assertion that the computation is principal-independent
and that the host authorizes every reader (spec 004, 3.1.4).

Reuse only within one tenant, context revision and effective
principal scope. The default.
Every request resolved and the core finished a judgment.
The caller cancelled; no judgment was finished.

description:
`rustev.live-reexecution/1`: one live re-execution, bounded by
`REPLAY_V1`. Holds no credential and no secret authorization material.

decision_id.description: The new decision; never the historical one.

effects.description: One per proposed external attempt, in proposal order.

run_digest.description:
The record digest of the new run record; absent only when the
record has no record canonical form, which nothing then matches.

snapshot_id.description: Computed from the current snapshot by the runtime.

unreconciled.description:
Attempts whose charge is unknown: outstanding liability for the host
to reconcile (spec 003, 3.5.5). The record is never rewritten.

title: rustev.live-reexecution/1
